question.text: Mahaganga Infrastructure Fund (Cat II AIF) pays INR 15 crore of investment management fees to its Investment Manager SPV in FY25. What is the GST treatment?

answer.text: GST at 5% concessional rate, borne by the IM
GST at 18% on the management fee, levied on the supply by the Investment Manager to the Fund - the Fund bears the GST cost
Exempt - financial services to AIFs are nil-rated
GST at 28% as a luxury service

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook (pages 125 and 148-149) confirms GST at 18% applies to investment management and trusteeship fees payable by the Fund to the Investment Manager/Trustee, and worked examples include GST as part of the Fund's total cost. At an INR 15 crore fee, 18% GST equals INR 2.7 crore borne by the Fund. The Trap: Option A - 5% is not an AIF-relevant rate. Option C - AIF management services are not exempt; the financial services GST exemption is narrow and does not cover fund management. Option D - 28% applies to sin/luxury goods, not financial services. Note: The 18% rate and the incidence on the Fund (rather than the Manager) are supported by the workbook examples on pages 483-484, which treat GST as a recurring cost line in the Fund's total expense build-up.
